title: Manuscript hygiene
social: Word hides what you actually typed. One shortcut shows every tab, double space and empty line.

title: Choosing a book font
social: One face for the body, one for headings. On a Kindle the reader can overrule you anyway.

title: Margins and bleed
social: The gutter is where the glue lives. A margin is not white space you're wasting.
keyword: kdp print margin and bleed specs

title: Page breaks, not Enter
social: Tapping Enter to reach a new page is why blank screens turn up in the middle of a chapter.

title: Spacing and indents
social: An indent and a blank line say the same thing. Doing both is how a page looks homemade.
keyword: book line spacing and indentation rules

title: Headers and footers
social: Running heads and page numbers are a paper idea. A reflowing screen has no pages to number.
keyword: how to add page numbers in word for kdp

title: Print resolution
social: Your photo was sharp. Then the document compressed it and the export did it again.
keyword: kdp print book image resolution 300 dpi

title: Drop caps
social: A drop cap is a CSS float, not a picture. Ship it as an image and it stops being text.

title: Heading levels
social: Big and bold is not a heading. The contents, the navigation and screen readers all read the style.

title: Links that work
social: A link inside a book has to point at a bookmark. Point it at a page number and the font size breaks it.
keyword: add hyperlinks to kindle book format

title: Smart table design
social: Five columns fit a page and fall off a phone. A table nobody can see is a table nobody reads.

title: Bullets and lists
social: A line that starts with a typed dash is a paragraph wearing a bullet's coat.

title: Editing the AI out
social: Same facts, same words, different rhythm. That is the whole edit.
keyword: edit ai manuscript bypass ai detectors

title: Title and copyright
social: Opening straight into chapter one is what makes a book read like a draft.
keyword: kindle title page copyright page template

title: The print test read
social: Three passes on paper, and the first one is not reading.

title: Inside an EPUB
social: An EPUB is a zip with rules about its first file. The manifest decides what exists.

title: The NCX file
social: A contents page you typed is not the contents menu. The Kindle builds that from a file you never see.
keyword: kindle table of contents ncx file

title: Justified or ragged
social: Kindle justifies reflowable text by default. In a narrow column with no hyphenation, that is where the rivers come from.
keyword: kindle ebook justified or left aligned text

title: Media queries
social: A media query sees the screen width. It never sees the size the reader picked.
keyword: css media queries kindle epub devices

title: Diagrams as SVG
social: A diagram is lines and labels, not photography. Ship it as lines and it stays sharp.

title: EPUBCheck
social: Your reader app forgives a broken EPUB. The store does not, and it will not tell you which line.

title: The OPF metadata
social: The shop's form fills your listing. This file fills the reader's library.

title: Reflowable or fixed
social: Reflowable text bends to the reader. Fixed layout keeps your page and takes their font size away.

title: Colour on E Ink
social: If colour is the only difference, an E Ink screen loses the difference.
keyword: color contrast rules for e-ink kindle

title: Collapsing margins
social: 24px below and 16px above does not make 40. It makes 24. Margins merge.

title: Font licences
social: Paying for a font does not always buy the right to ship it inside a book you sell.
keyword: how to embed fonts in epub legally

title: Missing images
social: A grey box where a picture should be is nearly always one capital letter, or a file still on your website.
keyword: images not showing in epub solution

title: The stylesheet
social: A book stylesheet is mostly restraint: name the structure, set one gap, stop.

title: The cover image
social: A cover sitting in the folder is not a cover. The manifest has to point at it.
keyword: kdp cover image xml entry epub

title: Kindle Previewer
social: The app you opened the EPUB in is not a Kindle. Amazon's previewer is, and it is free.

title: Writing alt text
social: Decorative images take an empty alt. Everything else takes one sentence saying what it tells you.
keyword: how to write alt text for ebook images

title: Special characters
social: Symbols where an accent should be is an encoding bug. An empty box is a font bug. Different fixes.

title: Reader settings
social: They set the size, the face and the theme. You set everything that matters.
keyword: kindle e-reader font settings user view

title: A perfect B5 page
social: Margins decide the text block. The block decides how many characters land on a line.

title: The cleanup pass
social: Four spans for one sentence is what an export looks like. None of them mean anything.
keyword: remove span and class tags epub python

title: The thumbnail test
social: A shop is a grid of thumbnails. If the title can't be read there, nothing else gets a turn.

title: Cover geometry
social: A paperback cover is not a front. It is back, spine and front in one flat image sized to your page count.

title: Spine thickness maths
social: Add twenty pages and the cover is the wrong size. The spine is page count times paper.

title: The barcode safe zone
social: Amazon prints a barcode on your back cover whether you left room for it or not.

title: The print cover PDF
social: A press is fussier than a screen: no bleed, no embedded fonts, no flattening, no book.
keyword: export pdf for kdp print cover cmyk

title: Mockups
social: A mockup sells the book. The flat file is the book. Never let the two swap places.
keyword: placeit mockups and graphics for kdp

title: Prompting an AI cover
social: An image model paints well and spells badly. Ask for the art, set the title yourself.
keyword: generate book cover using chatgpt prompt

title: A cover series
social: A series is one design with a variable. Change that one thing, keep the rest.

title: Letter art
social: An ornamented letter has to be the whole picture, not decoration sprinkled round the type.
keyword: floral letter designs for book cover

title: Canva covers
social: A template with the words changed is still the template everyone else picked.

title: Metadata mismatch
social: A human compares your cover to your KDP form. A dropped subtitle is a rejection.

title: Out of margin
social: The printable page is smaller than the paper, and the inside margin grows with the page count.
keyword: fix out of margin errors kdp print

title: Spine text
social: A thin book's spine is a few millimetres wide. Print a name on it and the press puts it on your cover.

title: Low-resolution images
social: Upscaling adds pixels, not detail. The warning clears and the print is still soft.
keyword: upscale low resolution images kdp template

title: Unembedded fonts
social: Name a font in your PDF and the press shrugs. Send the font and it obeys.

title: The copyright flag
social: Amazon holding your book and asking you to prove the rights is a question, not a refusal. Silence is what kills it.

title: Wrong bleed settings
social: A cut that lands a hair outside the trim leaves a white line down your page. Bleed is what stops it.
keyword: fix bleed setting errors kdp upload

title: The ISBN already used
social: One ISBN is one format of one book. Move it to the hardcover and the upload stops dead.

title: Blank pages
social: A page can look empty and still hold something the printer counts. That is what gets flagged.
keyword: kdp rejection empty pages in manuscript

title: Cover size mismatch
social: Your cover's width is decided by three things, and none of them is the artwork.
keyword: fix cover size pdf mismatch on kdp

title: The KDP dashboard
social: Four tabs, and only one of them publishes anything. The rest report on it.

title: The launch previewer
social: The previewer measures geometry and judges nothing. Clear it, then order the proof.

title: Tax and bank setup
social: The tax interview comes before the first sale. Skipped, it costs you the highest rate.

title: Territories and rights
social: Ticking worldwide is right until someone else holds the rights somewhere. Then it is a contract problem.
keyword: kdp worldwide rights vs individual territories

title: Expanded distribution
social: Expanded distribution pays 40% instead of 60%. The wider shelf is real, and you buy it with royalty.
keyword: kdp expanded distribution pros and cons

title: Pricing: 8.99 or 9.99
social: 8.99 and 9.99 pay the same royalty rate. One step past 9.99 and it halves.

title: The 99-cent ending
social: The last two digits of your price are a signal, not a strategy. The royalty difference is pennies.

title: A pre-order
social: The date that binds you is the file deadline, not the release you announced.
keyword: how to set up kindle ebook preorder

title: Linking the editions
social: Two listings split your reviews. Amazon merges them only when the title and author match exactly.
keyword: link kindle ebook and paperback kdp

title: What printing costs
social: Royalty is a share of what is left after printing. Page count is the lever you control.
keyword: kdp print cost calculator per book

title: Screen readers
social: A screen reader follows your file's structure, not your design. Bold text is silent to it.

title: The Accessibility Act
social: Selling into the EU since June 2025 means the accessibility basics are law, not a nicety.

title: Right-to-left books
social: Right-aligned text is not a right-to-left book. Direction is declared twice, in the file.

title: Bengali on Kindle
social: A Bengali line is not letters in a row. The shaping lives in the font, so ship the font.

title: Scrivener exports
social: What you see while writing is not what Scrivener exports. Compile decides the book.

title: Vellum or by hand
social: An app buys you an evening. Doing it yourself buys control that carries to the next book.

title: Footnotes or endnotes
social: A reflowing screen has no bottom of the page, so a footnote becomes a journey. Give it a way back.

title: Multi-level contents
social: Four levels of contents is a wall of indents nobody scrolls. Two is the useful depth.

title: Device testing
social: Your laptop is the one screen nobody will read the book on.

title: Error codes
social: Forty EPUBCheck lines are usually four faults. Fix the first one and half the list disappears.

title: MOBI is dead
social: Amazon stopped taking MOBI. If that is still your master file, it has nowhere left to go.

title: Back matter
social: Front matter is spent out of the free sample. The back of the book is the only free space you have.
keyword: book back matter order self published

title: Embedding a font
social: Embedding puts your font in the file. The reader's device still gets a vote.

title: Poetry line breaks
social: Where a line ends is the poem. A wrap that looks like a line break is a rewrite you did not make.

title: Code blocks
social: A phone gives your code about forty characters. Past that the indentation starts lying.

title: Maths with MathML
social: Text where you can, MathML where you must, a picture only as a last resort with the equation in its alt text.

title: Picture books
social: Fixed layout keeps your spread and takes the reader's font size. It is a trade, not an upgrade.

title: Ingredient tables
social: A four-column recipe loses its method column on a phone, and strands 200 on a line away from the flour.

title: Workbooks
social: An ebook has nowhere to write. Put the exercise on paper, or on a sheet they can print.

title: DRM: on or off
social: DRM is a lock on the file, not on the internet, and you only get to pick once.
keyword: kdp drm vs no drm ebook

title: Updating a book
social: You can replace the file. You cannot replace the copy already on somebody's shelf.

title: A heavy EPUB file
social: Pictures make an ebook heavy. One giant file makes it slow. Two different fixes.
keyword: epub file size optimization large book

title: ONIX metadata
social: You rarely write ONIX by hand. You do decide what goes in it, in the form you already filled.

title: Large print
social: Large print is a second paperback with its own ISBN, not a bigger font in the same file.
keyword: kdp large print book font size

title: Choosing a trim size
social: Trim size isn't taste. It sets the page count, the spine and your lowest price.

title: Pages and locations
social: A location is a position in your file. Only a paper edition has a page 112.
keyword: print page numbers vs ebook location

title: Front matter
social: Six pages of front matter means the free sample ends before your book begins.

title: Names and spelling
social: Consistency is a list, not a memory. Keep it while you write, and search both spellings.

title: Series formatting
social: Book two is book one with the words swapped. Everything else belongs in a template.

title: Read-aloud
social: A device reads any book for free. An overlay is your voice, and it has to be made.

title: Glossary and index
social: An index entry that still says page 112 is a dead end. Point it at the text instead.

title: Comics and manga
social: A comic page on a phone is six thumbnails. The panel has to become the page.
keyword: comic manga fixed layout epub kdp

title: Dark mode
social: A white box on a dark page is a lamp. Set only the colours you actually mean.

title: Google Docs
social: Docs makes a chapter title look like a chapter. A converter needs it to be one.
keyword: google docs to epub kindle clean

title: Before you upload
social: None of it is new. It is the book you already made, checked in the order that finds things.
keyword: ebook formatting qa checklist before kdp
